verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source framework (github.com/google/adk-python) that can be run entirely locally/self-hosted via CLI commands like `adk run`, `adk web`, and `adk deploy docker --with_ui`, and docs explicitly note it can run offline/disconnected from Google Cloud with no hard dependency on managed services. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted production deployment, and no explicit self-hosting guide beyond Docker/local dev commands.
